I see you are experiencing fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. To better understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements or the amount of urine you produce?

REQUEST TEST: TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone)

speaker: Doctor
text:
That TSH level is elevated, which strongly suggests hypothyroidism. To confirm this, have you been experiencing dry skin, hair loss, or constipation?

REQUEST TEST: Free T4

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Hypothyroidism. The combination of elevated TSH and low Free T4 confirms this diagnosis. Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or feeling depressed recently?
